items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: when Gladys paid me off... We played two nights and she handed me twenty dollars. I said, 'What is this?' She said, 'Well, this is your salary.'

ctx.x: you know. Well, you never know. I'll tell you, when Gladys paid me off, she said, "What is this here?" She handed me two ten dollar bills. We played two nights and she handed me twenty dollars. I said, "What is this?" She said, "Well, this is your salary." I said, "Salary? I was making seventy dollars a week in Detroit, and I quit that to come out here. I can't go for this kind of money." So she said, "Well, you either have to go back or forget it, because we don't pay no more than that." And I was so amazed,…
Didn't you discuss salary in front?
